input-field.name: apiUrl
input-field.label: TackQuote API base URL
TackQuote API-Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Base URL of the TackQuote API, including /v1 and no trailing slash. Use http://localhost:3001/v1 for local development.
Basis-URL der TackQuote-API inkl. /v1, ohne abschließenden Schrägstrich.

input-field.name: tenantSlug
input-field.label: TackQuote tenant slug
TackQuote Mandanten-Slug
input-field.helpText: Your TackQuote workspace slug (e.g. "demo"). Required for the storefront "Request a Quote" button — it is submitted with every quote request so TackQuote routes it to the right account.
Der Slug deines TackQuote-Workspace. Wird für den Angebots-Button im Storefront benötigt.

input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: TackQuote API key
TackQuote API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: Create under TackQuote → Settings → Developer → API Keys. Not required for the storefront quote button today (that endpoint is tenant-slug scoped, not API-key authenticated) — reserved for a future dedicated Shopware plugin endpoint (order sync / catalog push). See this plugin's README for details.
Aktuell nicht für den Angebots-Button erforderlich. Reserviert für zukünftige Auftragssynchronisierung.

input-field.name: enableButton
input-field.label: Show "Request a Quote" button on product pages
"Angebot anfordern"-Button auf Produktseiten anzeigen
